results.name: reminder query exposes only controlled status
first close cancellation stays visible without marking seen
confirmed close flushes and hides into a live tray
actual tray double-click handler restores minimized same window
tray menu pause and resume synchronize renderer and revision
lock contract covers minimize hide and synthetic screen-lock without claiming vault lock
unsubscribe removes callback without exposing arbitrary IPC
dirty settings conflict cannot be cleared by a passive refresh
committed settings expose snapshot failure and retry clears warning
renderer loss is distinct from disk failure and preserves committed data

limits: Menu handlers invoked programmatically; dialog responses injected for automation.
Synthetic screen-lock exercises the event contract only; no vault or physical lock test.
